title: feat: D− to A+ per-domain accessibility rating with systemic and popularity weighting
body:
Adds a letter-grade accessibility rating system (D− to A+) that goes beyond raw violation counts by factoring in recurrence across pages and page-traffic importance derived from DuckDuckGo seed data.

## Scoring model

Three multipliers stack on top of WCAG 2.2 AA severity base penalties:

| Severity | Base pts | Systemic (≥3 pages) | Priority page |
|----------|----------|---------------------|---------------|
| Critical | 8 | ×2.00 | ×1.50 |
| Serious | 5 | ×1.75 | ×1.30 |
| Moderate | 2.5 | ×1.50 | ×1.15 |
| Minor | 1 | ×1.20 | ×1.05 |

Total penalty is normalised by page count → 0–100 score → letter grade (A+ at 97–100 down to D− below 63).

## New files

- **`src/types/domain-rating.ts`** — `LetterGrade`, `SeverityRatingBreakdown`, `DomainAccessibilityRating` types
- **`src/engine/reporters/domain-rating.ts`** — `DomainRatingScorer` class + exported `scoreToLetterGrade()`; `buildAllDomainRatings()` accepts the `PrioritySeedSnapshot` directly to look up per-target seed URLs

## Changed files

- **`bug-exporter.ts`** — `exportMarkdownReport` gains optional `seedUrls` param; each report now opens with an `## ♿ Accessibility Grade` section (grade badge, score, penalty driver summary, severity breakdown table)
- **`dashboard-compiler.ts`** — adds `prioritySeedSnapshot` to options; renders a server-side "Domain Accessibility Grades" card with colour-coded grade badges (green A / blue B / amber C / red D, dark-mode aware); linked from in-page nav
- **`priority-seeds.ts`** — adds `getActiveSnapshot()` so the orchestrator can pass the live snapshot downstream
- **`src/index.ts`** — wires seed URLs into the bug exporter and snapshot into the dashboard compiler

## Tests

40 new unit tests in `tests/unit/domain-rating.test.ts` covering grade boundary mapping, systemic threshold (exactly 3 pages triggers multiplier), priority-page multiplier, per-page deduplication of rule instances, rawCount accumulation, `buildAllDomainRatings` sort order, and `buildPenaltyDriverSummary` annotations.
